question: Should release validation preserve the current Kova evidence contracts and wait for a narrow forward fix, or intentionally accept the 165-commit rollback as a temporary downgrade?
rationale: The rollback restores workflow availability but removes substantial evaluator hardening, so the release and evaluator owners must explicitly accept or reject that integrity tradeoff.

options.title: Require a forward fix
options.body: Keep the current evaluator line and pin the smallest Kova repair that makes the exact candidate produce complete records.

options.title: Accept the temporary downgrade
options.body: Merge the older pin only after artifact-level proof confirms every required current release-evidence and cleanup contract remains enforced.

options.title: Pause validation
options.body: Leave the authoritative performance lane blocked until upstream Kova has a proven current-line repair.

recommendation.title: Require a forward fix
recommendation.body: Keep the current evaluator line and pin the smallest Kova repair that makes the exact candidate produce complete records.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and documented the current OpenClaw workflow contract and are the strongest available owner for the release-validation tradeoff.
